europe_now.title: EU Chief Proposes Associate Membership for Canada
europe_now.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen backed a plan during her State of the Union address to offer Canada associate membership status within the European framework. The announcement caught several EU capitals off guard as regional leaders weigh future geopolitical alignments.

sources.headline: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
EU capitals caught off guard as von der Leyen announces ‘associate membership’ for Canada

europe_now.title: US Charges Alleged Russian Intelligence Agents Over Assassination Plots
europe_now.summary: United States authorities have announced criminal charges against five alleged agents connected to Russia for plotting assassinations targeting Ukraine allies. The international security operation highlights growing concerns over state-sponsored terror networks operating across regions.

sources.headline: US announces charges against five alleged agents for Russia over assassination plots
US exposes alleged Russian terror network targeting Ukraine allies

top_stories.title: European Union State of the Union Address
top_stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen delivered her State of the Union address addressing global threats and institutional reforms. Her proposals included the creation of a European Security Council and initiatives to address the rising EU-China trade deficit.

top_stories.title: Kosovo War Crimes Verdict
top_stories.summary: Former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci faced a war crimes verdict delivered by the tribunal in The Hague. The court subsequently sentenced him to 25 years in prison following the judicial proceedings.
